sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal man, short receding side-part brown/grey hair and brows, full short salt-brown moustache and chin/jaw beard, no glasses. Maroon-brown broad-lapel jacket, white pointed shirt, black bow tie. Serious closed mouth and blue backdrop. Preserve beard/moustache/hair/brows, outfit/crop/light, short broad fitted mascot neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal clean-shaven man, short side-part light brown hair/dark brows, round fine metal spectacles over eyes. Off-white lab coat, white pointed shirt, navy tie; source-cropped tan clipboard with large metal top clip at viewer right. Serious mouth, blue background. Preserve glasses, hair/brows, clipboard/coat/shirt/tie/crop/light, short broad mascot neck and clean chin.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal man, short dark brown slicked-back hair and brows, small dark moustache only, clean chin. Burgundy broad-lapel suit, pale blue-grey pointed shirt, navy tie with diagonal red stripes. Serious closed mouth, blue background. Preserve moustache only/hair/brows/outfit and crop/light; compact rounded mascot, short broad collar transition.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal clean-shaven man with short receding dark hair/brows, single gold-rim monocle over viewer-left eye and thin gold chain looping to lapel. Charcoal/navy broad-lapel coat, pale high white/grey shirt with small round center buttons, red bow tie. Serious mouth, blue background. Preserve monocle/chain/hair/brows and outfit/crop/light; clean chin, short broad fitted mascot neck.
